no_dependency_evidence.claim: The suite needs no third-party package.
no_dependency_evidence.how_observed: The suite ran once under python3 -I -S, which removes site-packages from sys.path entirely, so a third-party import cannot resolve. It passed 175 tests. This is stronger than the absence of a pip install step, which only shows that nothing was installed during the run.

no_warm_cache_evidence.claim: The run depends on no warm cache.
no_warm_cache_evidence.how_observed: No actions/cache step and no cache: input on setup-python; ci_surface.py asserts both from outside the workflow text and additionally verifies that the checkout contains no bytecode beyond the two caches this commission inherited. It runs at step 5, before anything imports, because the first suite pass creates caches of its own.

boundaries.statement: The clean-clone runner could not clone the remote on the hosted runner. git reported 'fatal: could not read Username for https://github.com: No such device or address', so the repository is not anonymously readable and clean_clone.sh exited 70.
boundaries.consequence: The fresh-clone-from-the-real-remote claim is proved from inside this execution runtime, where credentials are available, and recorded in workstreams/po03/runtime/transcripts/clean-clone.json. It is not proved on GitHub Actions. Making it work there would need a token in the clone URL, which is a credential this commission forbids the workflow from requiring.
boundaries.why_not_a_failure: The step distinguishes exit 70, a refused clone, from a suite failure inside a successful clone. Treating a missing runner capability as a red build would train readers to ignore the signal.

boundaries.statement: unshare -rn does not work on the ubuntu-latest hosted runner, so offline_check.sh reported NOT_SUPPORTED with 'sandbox command failed: unshare -rn' and exited 3. Both baseline probes succeeded there, confirming the runner does have egress; what it lacks is the ability to remove it.
boundaries.consequence: The network-disabled claim for unit a3-u06 is proved inside this execution runtime, where the namespace is available, and recorded in workstreams/po03/runtime/transcripts/offline-suite.json with 145 tests passing and both probes failing inside the sandbox. On GitHub Actions it is unproven rather than false.
boundaries.why_not_a_failure: The script refuses to report a pass for a sandbox it never entered. A workflow that downgraded NOT_SUPPORTED to success would be claiming an offline run that did not happen.
